title: Rethinking Strict Dissipativity for Economic MPC
summary: Stability of economic model predictive control can be proven under the assumption that a strict dissipativity condition holds. This assumption has a clear interpretation in terms of the so-called rotated stage cost, which must have its minimum at the optimal steady state. However, contrary to dissipativity, for strict dissipativity the storage function cannot be immediately related to the value function of an optimal control problem formulated with the economic stage cost.
